messages:
toni: opened a quick PR to align function/tool-calling examples across SDKs and add a short migration note for older envelope shapes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5122

devon: nice. which canonical example are we picking? compact invoke({tool,input}) -> {result}?

toni: yes, compact on the main guide. add an appendix called 'Envelope compatibility' with a small normalize helper.

lee: FYI i found a few codegen examples still referencing tools[].output_schema; runtime is using tools[].response_schema. i'll raise a tiny rename PR and include a changelog blurb.

toni: thanks, please ping when that's up so i can reference it. also adding short run commands in PR description so reviewers can smoke-test examples.

lint-bot: docs-ci/lint -> PR 5122: 2 link warnings (old structured-output path), 1 schema-field mismatch flagged in docs/structured-output.md:line 134.

devon: i'll run a quick TS smoke test after lee's rename lands. plan: merge rename first, then update snippets and links.

toni: pushed an appendix with two patterns: preferred compact example and a defensive shim showing explicit checks for compact, envelope, and nested output.result. keeping snippets short.

lee: rename PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123 - includes migration diff and changelog note.

devon: running TS smoke now. one minor import path fix then should be green.

toni: timeline: aiming to merge before next SDK release. I'll follow up to add a redirect for any moved pages after merge. thanks all.
